items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Nvidia Leads 5 Stocks In Buy Areas, Sandisk Needs This; Walmart Looms
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq look ready to run, but they haven't quite done so. Sandisk surged but must do this. Walmart, Target loom.

items.title: Stock Futures Little Changed Ahead of Retail Earnings
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average finished the week down 0.6% on Friday, snapping a two-week winning streak.

items.title: Walmart, Target, Home Depot, Fed Minutes, and More to Watch This Week
items.summary: Lowe’s, TJX, Alibaba, and Toll Brothers will also report earnings. On the economic front, we’ll see Fed minutes, housing-market data, and readings on manufacturing and services activity.

items.title: Retail Earnings, Fed Minutes and Other Key Things to Watch this Week
items.summary: Markets face a retail-dominated week where Home Depot (HD), Target (TGT), TJX Companies (TJX), and Walmart (WMT) report earnings providing critical consumer spending assessment across income segments.

items.title: Sam Stovall’s Warning: Consumer Spending Will Collapse the Moment Banks Tighten Credit
items.summary: Sam Stovall says sentiment surveys are a distraction and that one specific corner of the financial system holds the real on-off switch for consumer spending. The signals hiding in this earnings season will tell investors whether that switch is about to flip.

items.title: What to Expect in Markets This Week: Earnings from Walmart, Target and Home Depot
items.summary: Major retailers’ quarterly results come after inflation softened in June and July.

items.title: Lifeway Foods Inc (LWAY) (Q2 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Record Sales Amidst Cost Pressures
items.summary: Lifeway Foods Inc (LWAY) posts 27th consecutive quarter of growth with $66.9M in net sales, but margin compression from milk and resin costs weighs on profitability.
